verdict.rationale: Fly.io provides infrastructure for autonomous background work: Sprites give each agent its own Linux box that checkpoints while the agent works and sleeps until needed, and Machines offer restart policies and a REST API for managing long-running processes. However, a community user reports that built-in cron-like scheduling is missing and must be built by running a permanent scheduler app, so users assemble the automation layer themselves. Missing for 10: native scheduled/triggered automation primitives, documented workflow or automation setup, and independent hands-on corroboration of Sprites running agents autonomously.
